 Serie A - Game Week 11 8 Nov 2026 - 09:00 Stadio Brianteo DAZN will broadcast Monza v Atalanta exclusively. Here's how to subscribe and watch the match live.
 Maurizio Sarri's Atalanta visit Ivan Juric's Monza at the Stadio Brianteo in the 11th round of Serie A fixtures. They arrive in Brianza needing to turn around a run of form that has taken a worrying turn in recent weeks.
 After a heavy 3-0 home defeat to Parma in the league, Atalanta managed only a 1-1 draw against Kairat Almaty in the Conference League. The Bergamo side have gone five matches without a win across all competitions, and they continue to concede with alarming regularity.
 Sarri also has a long injury list to contend with. Kossounou, Hien, Pompei, Kolasinac, Raspadori, Kessie and Gaetano are among those absent. The Tuscan manager again turns to Krstovic to lead the attack, with De Ketelaere and Rowe in support.
 Despite three consecutive defeats, Monza know they could capitalise on Atalanta's poor form. Juric must do without Pessina, Ziolkowski, Folorunsho and Kouadio Maye, but the Brianza side have shown in recent weeks that they can respond to adversity.
 Atalanta sit 13th in the table, while Monza are 18th. Both sides have more than three points riding on this match.

 Across all competitions, Atalanta have no wins, two draws and three defeats in their last five outings. A 1-1 draw against Kairat Almaty in the Conference League followed a 3-0 defeat to Parma in Serie A. Atalanta have scored nine goals and conceded 12 in those five matches. Their 4-4 draw against Frosinone and 2-2 draw against Fiorentina show just how vulnerable they have been at the back.
